title: Shirley & Beverly Russell, Backyard Garden - Vintage 1930s B&W Snapshot Photo
back_text_transcription:
Shirley & Beverly Russell
— 1935 —

Shirley has her great grand
mother Berry's dress on,
and Beverly has on a
jacket belonging to her
Great Grand Father W. T. Russell

C777
description: A sunny 1935 backyard snapshot capturing young Shirley Russell standing next to infant Beverly Russell, who is seated in a wooden high chair. As noted on the reverse, both children are dressed in family heirlooms: Shirley wears a delicate white lace dress belonging to her great-grandmother Berry, while baby Beverly wears a small jacket passed down from her great-grandfather W. T. Russell. The backdrop features lush garden foliage and bright summer sunlight.
